description: German property listings from immowelt.de for a city: per listing the property type, city, price in EUR, rooms, living area (m²), floor when given and listing URL (first page, ~30 listings), plus the market summary immowelt publishes for the search: number of offers and lowest/highest price. Apartments or houses, to buy or rent. Related tools on this server, for a different need: realestate_aqarmap when you need Egyptian property listings from Aqarmap for sale or rent; realestate_bienici when you need French property ads from Bien'ici for a city or area. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

city.description: German city as in immowelt URLs, e.g. berlin, muenchen, hamburg (required)
